task_description: Build A-Z anime list page showing all 1483 catalog entries and implement multiple video source fallback system for broken videos
findings: Completed implementation of A-Z list catalog with filters, sorting, and pagination showing all 1483 anime series. Implemented multi-source video player with localStorage preferences and manual fallback mechanism. 2 of 8 video sources are fully functional (Primary and Dailymotion). Minor improvements suggested: dynamic catalog count, rename 'Latest' to 'Most Watched', reduce MAX_RETRIES, and consider adding test coverage.
